text:
```yaml
name: Check AI Co-Authors

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-ai-co-authors:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install shellcheck
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck

      - name: Lint check-ai-co-authors.sh
        run: shellcheck .github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh

      - name: Run AI co-author check
        run: bash .github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh
```
